atoms.b: Some settlements have unique purposes beyond general living and working. We call these ((++specialised ordinary)) settlements.

instruction.text: Read the text and select the matching specialised settlement.

atoms.a: Ports are built close to bodies of water, such as a river or sea, and are used to transport and trade goods.
Market towns are used by local farmers and small businesses as a place to sell to the public. They may also help to increase tourism in the area.
Industrial towns are centres for manufacturing. They are often located close to sources of natural materials like coal, iron and timber.
Agricultural towns are located in the countryside, and the people there often work in farming.
What are some benefits of specialised settlements?

instruction.text: Let’s look at an example of a specialised settlement. Select Felixstowe on the map to learn more.
Read the text and answer the questions.

atoms.text: Built in 1967, the Port of Felixstowe on the Suffolk coast is the largest and busiest container port in the UK. Each year, Felixstowe receives around 2,000 ships and handles 3-4 million containers.
The port positively impacts the local economy and infrastructure in the town. It also creates various job opportunities in the region, such as in transportation.

What does the port of Felixstowe have a positive impact on?
